The Larder Cafe - Toa Payoh Central
Description / Notes: The Larder Cafe is located in the heartland of Toa Payoh. Practically every cafe serves waffles now so of course there are waffles here; pick from flavours like buttermilk, red velvet, green tea or charcoal. The cafe also offers brunch from 11am to 3pm with crowdpleasers such as the Pulled Pork Sandwich, Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict and easy to munch on Baked Egg and Bacon Cups. From 6pm to 9.30pm, dinner is served and you can tuck into Duck Confit and BBQ Pork Ribs. Among the more outstanding dishes is the Pistachio Herb Crusted Rack of Lamb which is cooked to tender perfection. Also try the Dowager's Fingers, served all day, along with other starters like Potato Munch Skins and Baked Escargots, these are little nibbles you can chew on all day while sipping a coffee. The long, claw-like "fingers" are small shrimp wrapped in crisp wanton skin. Cut through the oiliness of the wanton with the delicious honey sesame mayonnaise dip.
